report: Nginx started returning 502 Bad Gateway after a routine deploy. Error log shows connect() failed (111: Connection refused) while connecting to upstream 10.0.4.12:8080.
Several requests time out while acquiring a PostgreSQL connection. The service still responds intermittently and the database reports many active connections.
An internal HTTPS client fails with a certificate hostname mismatch. DNS resolution returns the expected service address.
A Kubernetes pod has restarted repeatedly. The last termination reason is OOMKilled and memory usage is close to the configured container limit.
